lessonRef.subject: ready-for-life
lessonRef.unitTitle: Body Signals and Building a Fueling Meal
lessonRef.title: Application or project: planning and ingredient checks

standardsRefs: Manuel Academy local Ready for Life composition
objective: I can practice planning and ingredient checks. I will do one step at a time and check one result.
scenario: The learner plans out one no-heat meal they intend to actually build later, checks the ingredients they planned against what's really available (in the kitchen or a provided inventory), and revises the plan for anything missing rather than assuming it'll be there.
safetyNotes: This is a planning-and-checking task, not food preparation; no heat or sharp tools are used.

simulationAlternative.description: If checking a real kitchen's ingredients isn't available, the learner instead checks their draft plan against a provided sample ingredient inventory list, revising for any 'missing' item the same way as the guided task.

materials: adult-or-local: access to the kitchen or a provided ingredient inventory

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g5-u04-l04-model-card. Watch one complete example.

prompts.text: Name the first move in the model and explain why it comes first.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g5-u04-l04-guided-card. Do the coached move.

prompts.text: Name the move you completed and the success check it meets.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g5-u04-l04-independent-card. Choose one complete route. Follow its steps.

prompts.text: Which complete route did you use?
Record the completed step numbers and one non-sensitive result statement.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g5-u04-l04-evidence-record. Save one result and one reflection.

prompts.text: What's one thing you learned from this check that you'll do differently the next time you plan a meal — checking earlier, planning backup ingredients, or something else?

remediation: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g5-u04-l04-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step. Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g5-u04-l04-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check. Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments. Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g5-u04-l04-retry-pair without the coach prompt. Exit: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Thoroughness of the check: Checks every ingredient on the draft plan. | Quality of revision: Revised plan only uses available ingredients. Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g5-u04-l04-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.
extension: Plan a second meal for a different day using only ingredients that are currently available, without needing a first-draft revision step.

productionDepth.practicalGoal: I can practice planning and ingredient checks. I will do one step at a time and check one result.

duration.sessionPattern: 5 minutes model, 5–7 minutes guided try, 10–15 minutes learner task, 5 minutes evidence and retry check
duration.adultTime: No adult time required unless the learner chooses support

localMaterials.availabilityRule: Use only when already available, safe, permitted, and appropriate. The complete fictional route replaces unavailable real-world access.

localMaterials.label: access to the kitchen or a provided ingredient inventory
localMaterials.availabilityRule: Use only when already available, safe, permitted, and appropriate. The complete fictional route replaces unavailable real-world access.

resources.title: planning and ingredient checks worked model
resources.purpose: Shows the starting condition, visible moves, reasoning, and success check before the learner begins.
content: Starting condition: The learner plans out one no-heat meal they intend to actually build later, checks the ingredients they planned against what's really available (in the kitchen or a provided inventory), and revises the plan for anything missing rather than assuming it'll be there.
Model move 1: Read the condition and name the exact planning and ingredient checks decision or action.
Model move 2: Before checking availability, write your first-draft meal plan: what ingredients would you use if everything were available?
Model move 3: Check your planned ingredients against what's actually available (in your kitchen or a provided list), with an adult confirming what's really on hand.
Model check: Thoroughness of the check: Checks every ingredient on the draft plan. | Quality of revision: Revised plan only uses available ingredients.

resources.title: planning and ingredient checks action steps
resources.purpose: Provides the ordered directions used by the model, guided attempt, independent task, and retry.
content: 1. Read the goal for planning and ingredient checks.
2. Watch the worked move on swk-rfl-g5-u04-l04-model-card.
3. Do one coached move on swk-rfl-g5-u04-l04-guided-card.
4. Complete the chosen route on swk-rfl-g5-u04-l04-independent-card.
5. Save the small record on swk-rfl-g5-u04-l04-evidence-record; use swk-rfl-g5-u04-l04-retry-pair if a step is missed.

resources.title: planning and ingredient checks coached first attempt
resources.purpose: Carries the complete first attempt and a fresh correction turn.
content: Fictional practice condition: The learner plans out one no-heat meal they intend to actually build later, checks the ingredients they planned against what's really available (in the kitchen or a provided inventory), and revises the plan for anything missing rather than assuming it'll be there.
Coach direction: Before checking availability, write your first-draft meal plan: what ingredients would you use if everything were available?
Learner prompt: List your first-draft ingredients.
Feedback check: name the move completed, point to the matching success check, and identify one missing or uncertain step without judging the learner.
Fresh correction turn: use the same fictional condition with one constraint changed; restate the changed constraint, redo only the affected step, and check the new result.

resources.title: planning and ingredient checks complete application
resources.purpose: Contains the lesson-specific application directions and prompts; it is the delivered card referenced by the learner flow.
content: Application direction: Check your planned ingredients against what's actually available (in your kitchen or a provided list), with an adult confirming what's really on hand.
Response 1 (t2-p1): I checked every ingredient on my draft plan, not just the ones I assumed were there.
Response 2 (t2-p2): For each missing ingredient, I named a specific substitute or removed it from the plan.
Response 3 (t2-p3): My revised plan only uses ingredients that are actually available.

Equal-access rule: If checking a real kitchen's ingredients isn't available, the learner instead checks their draft plan against a provided sample ingredient inventory list, revising for any 'missing' item the same way as the guided task.

resources.title: planning and ingredient checks minimal evidence record
resources.purpose: Defines exactly what the learner saves and what must not be collected.
content: Record only: selected route, completed step numbers, one non-sensitive result statement, and one revision if a step changed.
Reflection: What's one thing you learned from this check that you'll do differently the next time you plan a meal — checking earlier, planning backup ingredients, or something else?
Success checks: Thoroughness of the check: Checks every ingredient on the draft plan. | Quality of revision: Revised plan only uses available ingredients.
Do not collect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations; account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details; photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules.

resources.title: planning and ingredient checks supported and parallel retry cards
resources.purpose: Delivers a real correction loop rather than a direction to try again without support.
content: Contrast reteach: compare the model check on swk-rfl-g5-u04-l04-model-card with the missed or unsupported step; name the one observable difference.
Supported card: return to swk-rfl-g5-u04-l04-guided-card, complete the affected move with one coach prompt, and receive criterion-specific feedback.
Parallel card: use a fresh fictional planning and ingredient checks condition with one changed constraint; complete the same move without the coach prompt.
Exit check: the corrected move meets this lesson's checks — Thoroughness of the check: Checks every ingredient on the draft plan. | Quality of revision: Revised plan only uses available ingredients..
Return: resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g5-u04-l04-independent-card; a physical route resumes only when the authorized adult says it is safe.

realRoute.title: planning and ingredient checks — permitted real-life route
realRoute.permissionRule: Use only a safe, permitted setting and the materials already available to you.
steps: Confirm the setting, materials, and stop condition before acting.
Check your planned ingredients against what's actually available (in your kitchen or a provided list), with an adult confirming what's really on hand.
Complete the response prompts on the delivered independent card without recording private identifying details.
Check the result against the delivered evidence record and correct any missed step.
realRoute.completionCondition: The learner submits the minimal process record and the completed application responses.

retry.trigger: Start the correction loop when a required step is missing, the reason does not match the condition, a safety or privacy boundary is crossed, or the evidence does not show the stated result.
retry.targetedReteach: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g5-u04-l04-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step.
retry.supportedReattempt: Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g5-u04-l04-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check.
retry.feedback: Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments.
retry.parallelReattempt: Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g5-u04-l04-retry-pair without the coach prompt.
retry.exitCriterion: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Thoroughness of the check: Checks every ingredient on the draft plan. | Quality of revision: Revised plan only uses available ingredients.
retry.returnPath: Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g5-u04-l04-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.

guardianInvolvement.role: Optional coach only; no guardian attestation is required.
guardianInvolvement.signOffBoundary: A guardian attestation certifies only that the named physical event occurred. It never scores the learner reflection or proves effort, honesty, maturity, responsibility, diagnosis, or character.

safety.stopRule: Stop the physical route when permission, supervision, a safe setting, or an expected material is missing, or when a new hazard appears. Continue only when the authorized adult resolves it; otherwise use the complete fictional route.
safety.physicalBoundary: The learner follows the source safety notes and never performs adult-only handling, transport, account, legal, medical, heat, sharp-tool, electrical, chemical, or machine actions.
safety.noShameRule: Describe only the observable step, condition, evidence, or revision. Never label the learner, household, body, ability, effort, maturity, responsibility, or character.

privacy.rule: Collect the smallest process record that shows the lesson steps. A learner may choose fictional details and may decline private disclosure without losing credit.
doNotCollect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations
account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details
photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules

may: coach the guided and retry cards
mayNot: observe or claim a physical condition
tutorBoundary.physicalCompletionRule: Tutor or AI may coach. Tutor or AI may not certify that a real-world physical action occurred.
tutorBoundary.missingResourceAction: Stop and name the unresolved resource. Do not fabricate it; use another complete delivered route only when every resource for that route resolves.
